shots.framing: very wide geography-establishing room master from a high public-side corner; both principals are small full-body figures within the architecture
shots.background_direction: about ten adults occupy roughly sixty percent of seats and safe walkways with quiet natural activity
shots.action: Show the full room at once: entry and clear floor path frame left, several occupied chair rows centre and background, and the complete warm-wood reception counter with rear-facing workstations frame right. Keep eight to twelve background adults distributed across seats and safe walkways. Keep the patient a small full-body figure approaching from public screen left and the nurse a separate small full-body figure behind the counter screen right in her open warm-grey cardigan. He gives one natural cough into his elbow. Distant three-quarter profiles only; nobody faces or performs for the camera.

shots.framing: natural shallow-focus counter-side foreground detail within the established axis
shots.background_direction: one adult visitor finishes at reception while others continue ordinary quiet waiting
shots.action: The nurse naturally returns a thin blue-and-white plastic card edge-on to a departing adult; its face stays moving, occluded and out of focus. The patient notices only briefly, then glances toward his own jacket pocket. Plausible fingers and counter contact; no hero framing.

shots.framing: restrained nurse profile medium close-up facing screen left
shots.action: The nurse acknowledges him with composed warmth and a small professional nod.

dialogue.speaker: nurse
dialogue.line: Hi. What brings you in today?

shots.framing: restrained patient profile medium close-up facing screen right
shots.action: He speaks steadily with tired restraint, stable and not in acute distress.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.line: I've had this cough for six weeks. It won't clear, and it's worse at night.

shots.framing: matching nurse profile close-up facing screen left
shots.action: Her attention becomes slightly more clinically focused without exaggerated concern.

dialogue.speaker: nurse
dialogue.line: Are you short of breath now? Any chest pain?

shots.framing: matching patient profile close-up facing screen right
shots.action: He gives a small reassuring head movement, then admits the symptom persists.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.line: No. I'm okay. It just keeps coming back.

shots.framing: restrained nurse profile medium close-up facing screen left
shots.action: She returns to the ordinary intake rhythm with an open, professional expression.

dialogue.speaker: nurse
dialogue.line: All right. May I see your BC Care Card?

shots.framing: brief side-angle action insert across the counter, hands and controls secondary to faces
shots.action: The patient places one thin blue-and-white plastic card face-down on the public counter. The nurse takes the same card with plausible fingertips, keeps its face hidden, places it beside her rear-facing monitor, then uses ordinary keyboard and mouse motions. No readable screen, card face, letters, numbers, barcode or identifier; no fused fingers or shape changes.

shots.framing: nurse profile close-up facing screen left with a restrained hesitation
shots.action: After a brief breath, she delivers the result with empathy and no blame.

dialogue.speaker: nurse
dialogue.line: It looks like your MSP isn't active. You'll likely be charged for today's visit.

shots.framing: restrained patient profile close-up facing screen right
shots.action: His expression tightens only slightly; he stays controlled.

shots.framing: held nurse profile close-up facing screen left
shots.action: She explains the uncertainty carefully, professional and empathetic rather than defensive.

dialogue.speaker: nurse
dialogue.line: I can't say. It depends on today's care, and I don't want to quote the wrong amount.

shots.framing: held restrained patient profile reaction facing screen right
shots.action: He absorbs the unknown charge in controlled silence, eyes briefly lowering while the ordinary clinic continues behind him; no melodrama and no camera glance.

technical: explicit source provenance for every final interval
visual: stable counter, chairs, workstation, windows and circulation
performance: one or two natural coughs only
all eight dialogue turns are lip synchronized
